name: zclass_cls_di_build_pick_candidates_for_segment_vs_bbox_faces
description: zClass_cls_di::BuildPickCandidatesForSegmentVsBBoxFaces tests a segment against each face of a view-space bounding box and returns after the first hit.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this bbox-face helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass cls_di source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x485380 validates clearing candidate->scenePayload, staging each of the six bbox faces into g_zClass_DiFaceVertexScratch4 in original corner order, calling BuildPickCandidateForSegmentVsPolygon with vertexCount=4 and cullBackface=0, early return 1 on the first hit, and final boolean normalization for the last face.

The native cls_di smoke verifies a hit through the front bbox face, candidate scenePayload clearing, hit position and normal, scratch face vertex staging, and miss behavior when the segment stays outside the bbox.
